component.name: AbraFlexi MCP Server
component.summary: Model Context Protocol server for AbraFlexi integration

description.p: A comprehensive MCP server providing complete access to AbraFlexi REST API functionality through the Model Context Protocol, enabling AI assistants and other tools to interact with AbraFlexi accounting systems.

ul.li: Read-only mode by default for security
Support for STDIO and HTTP transports

description.p: Initial release with full AbraFlexi REST API tool coverage (invoices, contacts, products, bank transactions, generic evidence) over STDIO and HTTP transports.
